  "description": "Multi-agent coding architect with automatic self-improvement. 39 plainly named skills (modes fold overlapping ones: atlas-setup tour, atlas-dogfood smoke, atlas-frontend component and polish, atlas-run-watch PR targets, atlas-bakeoff verdict, atlas-brainstorm strategy, atlas-orchestrate feature flow, atlas-ship commit-only, atlas-status announce, atlas-audit act, atlas-sweep analyze). Core: atlas-orchestrate (execution engine, now with CE implementation-unit rigor: per-unit idempotency, proof-first/characterization test strategy, bounded parallel waves), atlas-audit (code/security audit, architecture map, self-telemetry), atlas-doctor (interactive self-improvement plus measurement-first retuning and a docs/lessons/ citation-drift refresh), atlas-setup (onboarding, install, connectors, Compound Pack health check, repair, tour), atlas-loop (recurring work), atlas-ux-test (UX runtime swarm), and 14 original task skills (atlas-orchestrate, atlas-debug with ranked-hypothesis/red-for-the-right-reason/three-failed-fix rigor, atlas-refactor, atlas-frontend, atlas-frontend component, atlas-db-audit, atlas-gitignore, atlas-handoff, atlas-harden, atlas-audit act, atlas-prompt, atlas-readme, atlas-validate, atlas-wiki). Ported from the Compound Engineering plugin onto atlas's own control plane (orchestrator, named agents, docs/.atlas SSOT, findings ledger, explicit-push-consent policy stay authoritative): the core loop atlas-brainstorm (WHAT-stage elicitation), atlas-plan (HOW-stage implementation-ready units), atlas-simplify (post-implementation three-persona simplification), atlas-review (risk-selected multi-persona typed-finding diff review), atlas-compound (eligibility-gated durable learning capture), atlas-autopilot (consent-gated end-to-end pipeline); around-loop atlas-brainstorm strategy, atlas-pulse, atlas-sweep; on-demand atlas-bakeoff, atlas-bakeoff verdict, atlas-explain, atlas-prototype, atlas-optimize, atlas-sweep analyze; git workflow atlas-ship commit-only, atlas-ship, atlas-run-watch, atlas-resolve-pr-feedback, atlas-worktree; frontend/testing atlas-frontend polish, atlas-dogfood, atlas-test-xcode, atlas-dogfood smoke, atlas-testing; collaboration atlas-proof, atlas-status announce. Plus Compound Packs (org/team prescriptive-rule roots, cited as evidence never instructions), 14 core agents, 12 MCP connectors, 17 hook programs / 22 bindings, and the atlas-orchestrate method: independent verification with runtime evidence before any done claim.",
